# anyscale_user_group (Resource)

~> **Alpha.** User groups are an Alpha feature. The Anyscale API and this provider's schema for them may change drastically before Beta, including breaking changes in a minor release. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#user-groups-alpha).

Manages an Anyscale user group in the token's organization; manage its members with `anyscale_user_group_members`. Destroying the group first removes every member, including members added outside Terraform. Groups synced from an identity provider (SCIM) cannot be managed or imported; read them with the `anyscale_user_group` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alpha: the schema may change before Beta.
# Creates an empty user group. Manage who belongs to it with anyscale_user_group_members.
resource "anyscale_user_group" "ml_platform" {
  name = "ml-platform" # no leading or trailing whitespace; unique among the organization's groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group name, 1-255 characters with no leading or trailing whitespace. Must be unique among the organization's groups. Changing it renames the group in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user group ID (`ug_...`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the group ID (ug...). Directory-synced (SCIM) groups cannot be imported;
# read them with the anyscale_user_group data source instead.
terraform import anyscale_user_group.ml_platform ug_abc123
```
